Generated from the model types in [`crates/canon/src/model`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/crates/canon/src/model): their doc comments, fields, field types and serde attributes. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/protocol-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types. For what the parts mean together, read [the language](../concepts/protocols.md); for the documents an evaluation reads and writes, see [evaluation documents](./documents.md).

Keys written with no value: a key left out takes its default, or is refused when it has none; a
key written with no value is an error.


## The document

A `protocol/1` source document as written.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | required | The document format; the validator accepts only `protocol/1`. |
| `protocol` | [`ProtocolHeader`](#protocolheader) | required | — |
| `artifacts` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) to [`Artifact`](#artifact) | optional | — |
| `evidence_kinds` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) to [`EvidenceKind`](#evidencekind) | optional | — |
| `claims` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) to [`Claim`](#claim) | optional | — |
| `obligations` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ObligationId`) to [`Obligation`](#obligation) | optional | — |
| `actions` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ActionId`) to [`Action`](#action) | optional | — |
| `outcomes` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`OutcomeId`) to [`Outcome`](#outcome) | optional | — |
| `invalidation` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`InvalidationRuleId`) to [`InvalidationRule`](#invalidationrule) | optional | The invalidation rules, keyed by rule id; a protocol without the section declares none. |
| `case` | [`CaseSection`](#casesection) | optional | What a case governed by the protocol gives when it opens: its case inputs. A protocol without the section declares no input. |
| `independence_dimensions` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`IndependenceDimensionId`) to [`IndependenceDimension`](#independencedimension) | optional | The independence dimensions the protocol's evidence matches may demand, keyed by dimension id; a protocol without the section declares none. |

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |

| `revision` | integer, 0 or more | required | — |

## `Artifact`

A thing whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |

## `EvidenceKind`

A kind of evidence the protocol admits.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `max_age` | [text](#text-formats) (`Age`) | optional | How old a record of this kind may be and still apply: at an evaluation instant later than its `observed_at` by more than this, it is excluded as expired (design § 8). |

## `Claim`

A proposition whose value is established from evidence by its predicate.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `true_when` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | required | — |

## `Obligation`

Something that must be done before the case can be complete. It is discharged only when its
discharge predicate, over claim values, evaluates true (design § 8). One with an applicability
predicate applies only when that predicate is not false: false, it is not applicable.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `discharged_when` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | required | — |
| `applicable_when` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | optional | When the obligation applies, over claim values and case inputs; always, when absent. |

## `Action`

A semantically named possibility: what it needs, what authority it requires, what effect it
has and what evidence it may produce (design § 10).

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `precondition` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | optional | — |
| `requires` | list of [`CapabilityRequirement`](#capabilityrequirement) | optional | — |
| `effect` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EffectClass`) | optional | — |
| `may_produce` | list of [`EvidenceProduction`](#evidenceproduction) | optional | — |
| `arguments` | any JSON value | optional | The JSON Schema, in Canon's argument-schema dialect, that the action's arguments satisfy. Absent: the action takes no arguments; a runner accepts only `{}`. Canon never validates arguments at run time: the runner that calls the action validates them against the schema, and `canon validate` holds the schema to the dialect (`action-arguments`). |

## `Outcome`

A legitimate terminal interpretation of a case and what it requires: a predicate, or an explicit
decision (`requires: decision: <name>`).

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `requires` | [`OutcomeRequirement`](#outcomerequirement) | required | — |

## `InvalidationRule`

An invalidation rule: a change of its upstream artifact's revision invalidates, for the claims
it names and every claim built on them, the evidence observed against an earlier revision of
that artifact (design § 4.1, CANON-INVALIDATION-001).

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `upstream` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | required | The artifact whose revision the rule watches. |
| `invalidates` | list of [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) | required | The claims whose support a change of that revision invalidates. |

## `CaseSection`

The protocol's `case:` section.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inputs` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`InputId`) to [`CaseInput`](#caseinput) | optional | The case inputs, keyed by input id. |

## `IndependenceDimension`

One independence dimension: a relation between who produced a record and the case's work,
which the trusted context resolves for each producer and Canon reads from the case.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |

## `Predicate`

A predicate over evidence and claim values.

The predicate language: a small, total, deterministic expression language (design § 39.2).

A predicate is one of `all`, `any`, `not`, an evidence match by kind, optional result and
optional subject, a test on a claim value, a test on a case input's value, or one of the four
order forms over the evidence history. Written in source as a map with exactly one of the keys
`all`, `any`, `not`, `evidence`, `claim`, `input`, `first`, `before`, `after` or `since`; a claim
test may add `is`, which defaults to `true`, and an input test adds `in`, the values it is true
for (`{input: severity, in: [high]}`).

The order forms read the evidence history: every record of their kind (about their `subject`
when they name one) that the evidence check accepted, including the records the exclusion
stages keep from evidence matches (`revision_mismatch`, `expired`, `invalidated`). A record's
place in the order is its `observed_at`; a record without one has no known place. An evaluation
compares every instant at one resolution, the coarsest precision written among the records
with an `observed_at`: each is read with its finer digits dropped, and two records read at one
instant are not ordered. Instant below means the instant at the evaluation's resolution.
`{first: {kind: K, result: R}}` asks whether the first record of `K` has result `R`: `unknown`
with no record or with a record without `observed_at`; otherwise, of the records at the
earliest instant, `true` when every one has `R`, `false` when none has, `unknown` when they
disagree. `{before: {first: K1, then: K2}}` asks whether the first record of `K1` was observed
strictly before the first record of `K2`: `unknown` with no record of either, `false` with a
record of `K2` and none of `K1` (a later `K1` record comes after it), `unknown` with a record of
`K1` and none of `K2`, `unknown` when a record of either has no `observed_at`, and otherwise
`true`, `false` or `unknown` as the earliest instants of `K1` and `K2` are earlier, later or
equal. `{after: {first: K1, then: {kind: K2, result: R}}}` asks whether some record of `K2`
with result `R` was observed strictly after the first record of `K1`: `unknown` with no record
of `K1`, `false` with no record of `K2` with `R`, `unknown` when a record of `K1`, or of `K2`
with `R`, has no `observed_at`, and otherwise `true` when one of `K2` with `R` comes after the
earliest instant of `K1`, `unknown` when one only shares that instant (other than the first
record itself: a record is not later than itself), and `false` when none comes after it. A
record of `K2` with another result takes no part. `K1` and `K2` may be one kind. A known limit:
a record bound to any earlier revision counts, whether or not the current revision descends
from it, since Canon does not know how revisions descend (story:revision-ordering).
`{since: {last: K1, then: {kind: K2, result: R}}}` asks whether a record of `K2` with result `R`,
at the subject and subject revision of the latest record of `K1`, was observed after that
record: `unknown` with no record of `K1`, `false` with no record of `K2` with `R`, `unknown`
when a record of `K1`, or of `K2` with `R`, has no `observed_at`; otherwise each latest record
of `K1` (one no record of `K1` is observed after) gives `true` when a record of `K2` with `R` at
its subject and subject revision, other than itself, is observed after it, `false` when every
such record is observed before it or there is none, and `unknown` otherwise, and the form is
`true` when every latest record gives `true`, `false` when every one gives `false`, and
`unknown` otherwise. A record at a revision descended from the latest record's does not count.

An evidence match may demand independence: `{evidence: {kind: K, result: R, independent_on: [D, ...]}}` reads a record only when it names a `producer` and the case's `independence` map
lists that producer on every dimension `D` (dimensions the protocol declares under
`independence_dimensions`). A record of the match's kind and subject that fails the demand is
not of the match, whatever its result: it neither establishes nor contradicts it, and is
excluded from it as `not_independent` (CANON-INDEPENDENCE-001). The order forms do not demand
independence.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `all` | list of [`Predicate`](#predicate) | True when every member is true; true when empty. |
| `any` | list of [`Predicate`](#predicate) | True when some member is true; false when empty. |
| `not` | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | — |
| `evidence` | [`EvidenceMatch`](#evidencematch) | — |
| `claim` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) | — |
| `is` | [`Truth`](#truth) | Allowed only beside `claim`. |
| `input` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`InputId`) | True when the case's value of the input is one of the values listed, false otherwise. |
| `in` | list of [identifier](#identifiers) (`InputValue`) | Allowed only beside `input`. The values the test is true for, written `in`. |
| `first` | [`FirstResult`](#firstresult) | Whether the first record of a kind, in the evidence history, has a result. |
| `before` | [`EvidenceOrder`](#evidenceorder) | Whether the first record of one kind, in the evidence history, was observed strictly before the first record of another. |
| `after` | [`EvidenceAfter`](#evidenceafter) | Whether a record of a kind with a result, in the evidence history, was observed strictly after the first record of a kind. |
| `since` | [`EvidenceSince`](#evidencesince) | Whether a record of a kind with a result, at the subject revision of the latest record of a kind in the evidence history, was observed after that record. |

## `CapabilityRequirement`

One capability an action requires authority for.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capability` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`CapabilityId`) | required | — |

## `EvidenceProduction`

One evidence kind an action may produce.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evidence` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | — |

## `OutcomeRequirement`

What an outcome requires.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `decision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`DecisionName`) | The outcome is legitimate only with an explicit decision of this name, for the outcome, taken at the case snapshot's current revision. |
| — | [`Predicate`](#predicate) | Written as the [`Predicate`](#predicate) itself, with its keys and no key of its own. The outcome is legitimate when the predicate is `true`. |

## `CaseInput`

A case input: configuration a case fixes when it opens, one of a closed, non-empty list of
values. Not evidence, so no evaluation has an unknown input.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `values` | list of [identifier](#identifiers) (`InputValue`) | required | The values the input may take. |

## `EvidenceMatch`

Matches evidence of one kind, optionally with one result, optionally only evidence about one
declared artifact (a match that names a subject reads only the records whose subject it is),
and optionally only evidence whose producer the case lists as independent on every dimension
`independent_on` names.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | — |
| `result` | text | optional | — |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | optional | — |
| `independent_on` | list of [identifier](#identifiers) (`IndependenceDimensionId`) | optional | The independence the match demands of a record's producer: declared dimensions, not empty, each once. A match without it reads records whoever produced them. |

## `FirstResult`

An order form: whether the first record of `kind`, about `subject` when it names one, has
`result`: the records at the earliest instant at the evaluation's resolution. It reads every
record of the kind the evidence check accepted, excluded or not.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind whose first record is read. |
| `result` | text | required | The result that first record is to have. |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | optional | The declared artifact the records read are about; without it, records about any artifact. |

## `EvidenceOrder`

An order form: whether the first record of kind `first` was observed strictly before the first
record of kind `then`, both about `subject` when it names one: the earliest instants of the two
kinds at the evaluation's resolution, an equal pair not ordered. It reads every record of the
two kinds the evidence check accepted, excluded or not.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind whose first record is to come first. |
| `then` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind whose first record is to come after it; another kind than `first`. |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | optional | The declared artifact the records of both kinds are about; without it, records about any artifact. |

## `EvidenceAfter`

An order form: whether some record of `then.kind` with result `then.result` was observed
strictly after the first record of kind `first`, all about `subject` when it names one: after
the earliest instant of `first` at the evaluation's resolution. It reads every record of the
two kinds the evidence check accepted, excluded or not. `first` and `then.kind` may be one
kind: a record is not later than itself.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind whose first record the later one is to come after. |
| `then` | [`LaterRecord`](#laterrecord) | required | The record that is to come after it: its kind and its result. |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | optional | The declared artifact the records of both kinds are about; without it, records about any artifact. |

## `EvidenceSince`

An order form: whether a record of `then.kind` with result `then.result`, about the subject and
subject revision of the latest record of kind `last`, was observed after that record, all about
`subject` when it names one. It reads every record of the two kinds the evidence check
accepted, excluded or not. `last` and `then.kind` may be one kind: a record is not later than
itself.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `last` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind whose latest record the later one is to come after, at its revision. |
| `then` | [`LaterRecord`](#laterrecord) | required | The record that is to come after it: its kind and its result. |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | optional | The declared artifact the records of both kinds are about; without it, records about any artifact. |

## `Truth`

A three-valued truth value. `Unknown` is not `False`.

Written `true`, `false` or `unknown`. A YAML boolean `true` or `false` is read as the same value.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `true` | — |
| `false` | — |
| `unknown` | — |

## `LaterRecord`

What an `after` form reads later than the first record of its `first` kind, and a `since` form
later than the latest record of its `last` kind: a record of `kind` with `result`.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind of the later record. |
| `result` | text | required | The result the later record is to have. |

## Identifiers

An identifier is text. A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). Each kind of identifier is its own type, so one cannot stand in for another. These are the kinds a `protocol/1` document use:

| Type | Identifies |
|---|---|
| `ProtocolId` | Identifies a protocol, independently of its revision. |
| `ArtifactId` | Identifies an artifact a protocol declares. |
| `ClaimId` | Identifies a claim a protocol declares. |
| `EvidenceKindId` | Identifies a kind of evidence a protocol declares. |
| `ObligationId` | Identifies an obligation a protocol declares. |
| `ActionId` | Identifies an action a protocol declares. |
| `OutcomeId` | Identifies an outcome a protocol declares. |
| `CapabilityId` | Names a capability an action requires authority for. |
| `EffectClass` | Names the class of effect an action has. |
| `DecisionName` | Names an explicit decision an outcome may require (`explicitly_inconclusive`). |
| `IndependenceDimensionId` | Identifies an independence dimension a protocol declares (`different_principal`). Canon gives no dimension a meaning; the trusted context that writes the case resolves it. |
| `InvalidationRuleId` | Identifies an invalidation rule a protocol declares. |
| `InputId` | Identifies a case input a protocol declares. |
| `InputValue` | One value a case input may take: an identifier its input declares. Read from any scalar, alike in the protocol and in the case: `values: [true, false]` declares the values `true` and `false`, and a case gives one as `flag: true`. |

## Text formats

These values are text in a fixed form, not identifiers. Canon refuses text that does not match its pattern, and also checks what the pattern cannot:

| Type | Written as | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `Age` | A length of time: a whole number without leading zeros, followed by `s`, `m`, `h` or `d` (`5m`, `24h`). Canon also refuses an age too long to count in seconds. | `^(0\|[1-9][0-9]*)[smhd]$` |
